# In Plain English

> > Tech media company founded by Sunil Sandhu offering simplified explanations, tutorials, and cheatsheets for JavaScript, Python, AI, and web development.

In Plain English operates multiple publications including JavaScript In Plain English, Python In Plain English, and Stackademic, focusing on making complex programming concepts accessible to developers of all levels. The site features educational content on AI assistants, microservices, LLMs, and practical tutorials using tools like OpenClaw, MCP, Node.js, and Claude.

## Key Topics

- Python
- JavaScript
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- OpenAI & Claude
- AI agents and assistants
- Microservices architecture
- Node.js
- Web scraping
- OpenClaw
- Software development education
- Beginner-friendly programming guides
- Tech concept explanations
- Open source tools
- Developer community

## Getting Started

- [In Plain English](https://plainenglish.io): Tech media company homepage featuring JavaScript, Python, and AI pubs
- [About | In Plain English](https://plainenglish.io/about): About page: Sunil Sandhu's tech media company founded in 2018
- [Basics: Cheatsheets for Popular Tools & Libraries](https://plainenglish.io/basics): Quick reference cheatsheets for Express.js, Node.js, and frameworks

## Core Concepts Explained

- [Explain: Tech Concepts Explained Simply](https://plainenglish.io/explain): Tech concepts simplified for junior devs, covering OpenClaw and more
- [What is Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)?](https://plainenglish.io/explain/what-is-object-oriented-programming): OOP fundamentals explained: classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism
- [What is a Microservice?](https://plainenglish.io/explain/what-is-a-microservice): Microservices architecture explained: independent services via APIs
- [How Do LLMs Use Tools?](https://plainenglish.io/explain/how-do-llms-use-tools): LLM tool use explained: function calling, APIs, MCP, and JSON-RPC

## AI & Machine Learning

- [AI - In Plain English](https://plainenglish.io/topics/ai): AI topic hub covering generative AI, RAG, Claude, and ML articles
- [Using GPT to Answer Questions from Multiple Text Files](https://plainenglish.io/blog/using-gpt-to-answer-questions-from-multiple-text-files): Python script for GPT-4 document Q&A using OpenAI API integration

## Web Development Tutorials

- [Creating a Login Form with React: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://plainenglish.io/react/creating-a-login-form-with-react-a-step-by-step-guide-042470): React tutorial: building secure login forms with useState and Vite
- [Creating a Simple Task CRUD App with Flask, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, and Docker](https://plainenglish.io/blog/creating-a-simple-task-crud-app-with-flask-postgresql-sqlalchemy-and-docker): Flask CRUD tutorial using PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, and Docker setup
- [Playbook for Building Your Own WYSIWYG Editor](https://plainenglish.io/web-development/playbook-for-building-your-own-wysiwyg-editor): WYSIWYG editor tutorial using contenteditable, HTML5, and JavaScript

## Automation & Advanced Topics

- [How I keep up with Next.js Canary Releases using N8N + MCP Automation](https://plainenglish.io/web-scraping/how-i-keep-up-with-next-js-canary-releases-using-n8n-mcp-automation): Next.js canary monitoring workflow using n8n automation and MCP servers

## Optional
